title: Toyota vs Honda
shortAnswer: Toyota is the world's largest automaker by sales (10.5M vehicles/year) and leads in hybrid technology with the Prius. Honda is known for engine reliability, the Civic's legacy, and strong motorcycle division.
verdict: Toyota for reliability and hybrid tech. Honda for engines and value. Both are legendary Japanese automakers.

lines.hook: Toyota sells two and a half cars for every one Honda moves.
lines.tape: One built the biggest car company on earth. The other built the better engine.
rounds: 10.5 million a year. Nobody on the planet sells more cars than that.
Toyota bet on hybrids decades early. Honda is still playing catch-up.
Here Honda wins outright. Its engines aren't just reliable, they're worshipped.
275 billion against 130. Toyota has the money to outspend anyone.
lines.verdict: Toyota wins on points. Pick Honda if you care more about the engine than the empire.

youtubeTitle: Toyota vs Honda: Which Japanese Giant Actually Wins?
youtubeDescription:
Toyota moves 10.5 million cars a year on $275 billion in revenue, with a hybrid lineup Honda can't match. Honda counters with engines that have a legendary reputation. We compare sales, hybrids, engines and revenue to settle it.

Figures accurate as of August 2026. Statistics change over time — see the full, maintained comparison at https://www.aversusb.net/compare/toyota-vs-honda
